In the 2 Miles walk, Gordon Waddingham, our recruit from Coventry Godiva H., proved a good winner with G. Oliver and Syd Jarlett once again gaining the minor placings
Syd James was well up, with McMullen, Bob Readman and Bert Clayton constituted our team. Gerald Warr had a battle with Gordon Waddingham and George Oliver.
Ron Kemp was 19th, George Checkley 32nd and Gordon Waddingham 34th. At 5 miles Gregory had a comfortable lead of 100 yards in 38.22 but was ruled out at about 5½ miles.

This year we managed to send a team for this race with the result that we scored first three places with Harry Churcher, Percy Wright, and Bert Clayton, with Gordon Waddingham making the fourth in ninth position.

Our President was on the spot on our arrival with a coat stand to complete the dressing room and we were further supported by Gordon Waddingham, Joe Coleman and Percy Wilson, the latter, as usual, managing to find a bike within a few minutes of his arrival.
